question: Which legendary surfer received the Lifetime Achievement Award at Laureus 2025?
solution:
p>The correct answer is __**Kelly Slater**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The legendary American surfer **Kelly Slater** was honored with the prestigious **Lifetime Achievement Award** at the **Laureus World Sports Awards 2025**.
 
• This award recognizes his extraordinary career spanning over **three decades** and his immense contribution to the sport of surfing globally.
 
• **Kelly Slater** is widely regarded as the greatest professional surfer of all time, having secured a record **11 World Surf League (WSL) titles** between **1992** and **2011**.
 
• Born on **February 11, 1972**, in **Cocoa Beach, Florida**, he holds the distinction of being both the **youngest** (at age **20**) and the **oldest** (at age **39**) world champion in the history of the sport.
